name: TURN_PROBE
meaning: line of sight blocked: sweeping probe yaw +-offset for a clear view (gives up past 0x400)

name: TURN_TURNING
meaning: clear yaw found: turning at g_camAutoYawRate until the every-8th-frame LOS check is clear

name: TURN_SIDE
meaning: all walls on one side: 500 ms side-turn at +-yawSpeed
